production.direction_en: Odelia’s chalk arrows lead beneath the city. The water is still, but something moves against its reflection.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch4_undercity — dripping water, low drone | post: bgm_ch4_undercity

commands.speaker: odelia_pike
commands.text: The nest is behind us. The Guild ward is ahead.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You did not have to follow us down here.

commands.speaker: odelia_pike
commands.text: I dislike unanswered tracks. Yours are the loudest.
